verdict_vs_market.quote: You asked for a market-competitive offer, and this one is well above market.

verdict_vs_current.quote: Year 1 pays about twice what you'd make by staying.

recommendation.quote: Before you sign, you could make one small, polite ask.

uses_public_incumbent_benchmark.quote: On Levels.fyi, the median yearly compensation package in San Francisco Bay Area totals $510K for Google PMs across all levels.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Refreshes aren't included, since they aren't guaranteed.

unsupported_claims.claim: Google new-hire equity vests on a 33/33/22/12 front-loaded schedule
unsupported_claims.quote: Several sources describe that schedule as 33% in year one, 33% in year two, 22% in year three, and 12% in year four.

Stock-price averaging window used for grant

ask_focus.quote: At most, make one friendly ask for $271K base, then accept whatever they say.

specific_ask_without_gap.quote: Is there any flexibility to bring the base to the top of the posted range, $271K?

rsu_annualized.quote: The 4-year average is about $697K a year without any refreshes

year1_vs_recurring.quote: Because vesting is front-loaded, your pay falls each year unless refreshes fill the gap. Plan around the lower years, not year 1.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: The $200K sign-on fully replaces the Meta stock you'd give up over the next year.
